title: The Tale of Liu Bei
summary: A penniless heir of the Han court has only a name and a promise. Win people to his side one by one, and decide what mercy is worth in a war.
summary_zh: 落魄的汉室后裔一无所有，只剩名号与誓言。你要一个个争取人心，也要决定乱世中仁义值多少代价。
character_brief: Liu Bei, mid-30s, male, long earlobes, plain green robe, calm and warm

title: The Tale of Cao Cao
summary: He is a hero in peacetime and a schemer in chaos. Serve beside the most ambitious man of the age and learn what it takes to hold an empire together.
summary_zh: 治世之能臣，乱世之奸雄。陪伴在这个时代野心最大的人身边，看他如何把天下一寸寸攥进手里。
character_brief: Cao Cao, 40s, male, sharp eyes, dark armor under a crimson cloak, confident smile

title: The Tale of Guan Yu
summary: Loyalty is easy to swear and hard to keep. Follow the red-faced general across five passes and discover what he will not trade for any price.
summary_zh: 忠义易誓难守。随红脸长髯的将军闯过五道关隘，看他究竟有什么东西无论如何不肯交换。
character_brief: Guan Yu, 40s, male, long black beard, green robe, crescent blade, stern gaze

title: The Tale of Zhuge Liang
summary: A hermit in a thatched cottage plans the whole realm on a map. Step out of the mountains and find out whether one mind can bend the age.
summary_zh: 草庐中的隐士在一张图上谋划天下。走出山林，看看一个人的智慧能否扭转一个时代。
character_brief: Zhuge Liang, 27, male, white feather fan, pale scholar's robe, quiet and sharp

title: The Tale of Zhou Yu
summary: Brilliant, proud, and under the gaze of a rival who sees through him. Stand beside the young admiral of Wu as the river fills with fire.
summary_zh: 才华横溢，心高气傲，对手却总能看穿他。陪在东吴年轻都督身边，直到江面燃起大火。
character_brief: Zhou Yu, late 20s, male, elegant, dark hair tied up, navy armor, a zither at his side

title: The Tale of Lü Bu
summary: The strongest warrior alive trusts no one and is trusted by no one. Ride with him and decide whether a man like that can ever choose a side.
summary_zh: 天下第一的猛将不信任何人，也无人信他。与他同行，看这样的人是否真能选定一个阵营。
character_brief: Lü Bu, 30s, male, pheasant-feather crown, red horse, halberd, restless and proud

title: The Tale of Diaochan
summary: She was given a role in a plot far bigger than herself. Walk the palace corridors with her and see where a chosen path turns into her own.
summary_zh: 她被安排进一场远比自己更大的棋局。与她走过宫廷长廊，看被安排的路从哪里变成她自己的选择。
character_brief: Diaochan, early 20s, female, long black hair, pale silk dress, quiet and watchful

title: The Tale of Zhao Yun
summary: One lone rider and a child in his arms against a whole army. Ride beside the steadiest spear of the age and learn what courage looks like when no one is watching.
summary_zh: 一骑一枪，怀中抱着幼主，面前是千军万马。陪伴这个时代最稳的长枪，看无人注视时的勇气是什么样子。
character_brief: Zhao Yun, 30, male, silver armor, white horse, spear, loyal and composed
